host: darwin/arm64; sysctl cpu, memsize, ncpu: Apple M5 17179869184 10
method: Each config runs its reps back to back against one Postgres container on the same host as the Go process. Per rep the bench queue is emptied, then 4 producer goroutines enqueue all jobs while the workers drain them. Throughput = jobs / (first enqueue to last handler start). Latency = enqueue timestamp carried in the job args to handler start, both read from the same process clock; percentiles are nearest-rank over every job in the rep. Summary = mean over reps with a two-sided 95% Student-t interval.

configs.name: conveyor before: completion per commit
configs.command: go run ./cmd/loadgen -dsn postgres://conveyor:conveyor@127.0.0.1:55499/conveyor?sslmode=disable -out results/bench-2026-10-23.json -reps 5 -jobs 2000 -name conveyor before: completion per commit -workers 4 -batch 8 -payload 128 -batched-complete=false

configs.name: conveyor notify per enqueue
configs.command: go run ./cmd/loadgen -dsn postgres://conveyor:conveyor@127.0.0.1:55499/conveyor?sslmode=disable -out results/bench-2026-10-23.json -reps 5 -jobs 2000 -name conveyor notify per enqueue -workers 4 -batch 8 -payload 128 -notify-debounce 0

configs.name: river default (fetch cooldown 100ms)
